$comment: Exceptions to tools/check-browser.ts, each with its reason. A page not named
here may shift 0.01 and call no Intl API before the reader acts. The check
reports an entry its page no longer needs, so this file can only shrink.
Three shift entries exist because CI's Worker has empty KV, R2 and D1: the
page is measured swapping its placeholder for a short fallback note, which
production, with its data, does not do (0 on all three, 2026-11-10).

/around.why: Local fallback only: the snapshot placeholder is sized for the real table and the empty-KV note is 80px. 0.031 to 0.051 locally.

/ledger.why: Local fallback only: the invoice placeholder is sized for real rows and the empty meter prints one line. 0.065 locally.

/lens/census.why: Local fallback only: the census has no rows to draw, so the footer settles 0.011.

intl./serendipity: Event times print in the visitor's own time zone with its short name, which only Intl.DateTimeFormat knows.
